repeated_proofs.singleton roles: R proofs of the same witness with fresh challenges give R independent row-combination functionals per column: the R-row plane is recovered linearly (no range assumption)
repeated_proofs.multi-member all-base roles: 2 fresh base functionals of the group's data per proof; linear recovery after (data dims)/2 proofs, sooner with integer ranges
repeated_proofs.P3 weights: the weights are the same in every proof by construction, so the repeated-proof accumulation applies to W in full; at nb_d nb_f = 1 two proofs recover Wg, Wu, Wd entirely in the linear model
repeated_proofs.activations: accumulation applies only when the same X is re-proven (re-verification, shared prefixes)
